subject: Cleanup and rename isExpiryTableValidForSamplingCb to expiryTableShouldSkipForSamplingCb (#2395)
reason: Pure refactor with no behaviour change: the callback is renamed and its return values changed from C_ERR/C_OK (-1/0) to 1/0, but its only caller, kvstoreScan at src/kvstore.c:400, uses the result as a boolean (skip_cb && skip_cb(ht)), and -1 and 1 are equally truthy while 0 is unchanged. The skip-sparse-expiry-table decision in activeExpireCycle is identical on both builds; the remaining hunks in kvstore.c and kvstore.h only edit comments. Nothing observable changed, so no scenario can distinguish the builds.
